title: 01 院前预警：先准备接手
01 Pre-alert: prepare to receive
info: 32岁男性，系安全带驾驶员，车辆侧向撞击；伤后约25分钟。主诉胸痛、气促和左大腿痛。短暂意识不清由目击者报告，持续时间不详。
A 32-year-old restrained male driver after a side-impact collision, about 25 min after injury. Chest pain, dyspnoea and left-thigh pain. Witnesses report brief unresponsiveness of uncertain duration.
unknown: 失血来源、气道污染、胸膜腔损伤、抗凝药和完整病史未明。
Bleeding source, airway contamination, pleural injury, anticoagulants and full history remain unknown.
priority: 按xABCDE分工；准备出血、气道、呼吸与循环资源并行接手。
Assign xABCDE roles; prepare parallel haemorrhage, airway, breathing and circulation resources.
reassess: 到院重新测量，核对氧疗方式、变化及院前措施效果。
Repeat measurements on arrival; verify oxygen delivery, changes and response to prehospital care.

oxygen: 空气；随后开始吸氧，现场流量未记录
Room air; oxygen then started, field flow not documented

question: 胸部症状明显，是否只准备胸部检查？
With prominent chest symptoms, should preparation focus only on the chest?
good: 保留全身威胁，团队并行准备并核对未知信息。
Retain whole-body threats, prepare in parallel and clarify unknowns.
bad: 单病种准备可能遗漏其他立即威胁。
Single-injury preparation can miss other immediate threats.

title: 02 接车交接：病史与院前措施
02 Handoff: history and prehospital care
info: 院前实施气道观察、吸氧、左大腿伤口加压敷料、肢体临时固定、脊柱保护、保暖、静脉通路及快速转运；未报告胸腔减压或输血。到院胸痛7/10，说短句、皮肤湿冷。过敏、既往病史、末次进食及药物尚待补全。

Prehospital airway observation, oxygen, pressure dressing over the left-thigh wound, temporary limb immobilisation, spinal precautions, warmth, IV access and prompt transfer. No chest decompression or blood transfusion reported. Arrival: chest pain 7/10, short phrases and cool clammy skin. Allergies, past history, last meal and medications still require clarification.
unknown: 不能因已处理伤口就断定止血充分，亦未确认休克机制。
A treated wound does not establish adequate haemorrhage control; shock mechanism is not yet established.
priority: 接手同时启动初评与复苏；复述措施、时间及未解风险。
Begin primary survey and resuscitation during handoff; repeat interventions, timing and unresolved risks.
reassess: 同一初评时间点，后续x/A/B/C/D/E卡不代表等待数分钟。
The following x/A/B/C/D/E cards share one survey time; they do not imply waiting minutes.

time: 到院0分钟 · 同一次初评
oxygen: 面罩氧疗6 L/min；实际FiO₂未测
Face-mask oxygen 6 L/min; actual FiO₂ unmeasured

question: 如何把交接转成当前的问题表征？
How should handoff become a current problem representation?
good: 高能量多发伤伴呼吸受损与灌注不足，机制仍需并行判断。
High-energy polytrauma with respiratory impairment and poor perfusion; mechanisms need parallel assessment.
bad: 只复述诊断名称会漏掉变化与未解问题。
Repeating a diagnostic label alone misses changes and unresolved questions.

title: 03 x + A：外出血与气道
03 x + A: bleeding and airway
info: x：左大腿敷料有血迹，交接后未见快速扩大；未测失血量。A：可说短句，无明显喉鸣，口内少量血性唾液；需持续确认气道通畅与保护。保持团队颈椎保护。

x: blood on the left-thigh dressing, without rapid expansion during handoff; blood loss unmeasured. A: short phrases, no obvious stridor and a little blood-stained saliva; airway patency and protection require continuing assessment. Maintain team spinal precautions.
unknown: 敷料外观不等于总失血量；能说话不等于气道风险已经关闭。
Dressing appearance does not quantify total blood loss; speech does not close airway risk.
priority: 具备资质团队处理立即威胁，学习者报告、协助与复评。
Qualified clinicians address immediate threats; learners report, assist and reassess.
reassess: 看敷料是否继续变化、声音/分泌物/意识是否改变。
Compare dressing changes, voice, secretions and consciousness.

time: 到院0分钟 · 同一次初评
oxygen: 面罩氧疗6 L/min；实际FiO₂未测
Face-mask oxygen 6 L/min; actual FiO₂ unmeasured

question: 能说话且敷料未扩大，能否完成x和A？
Can x and A be closed because he speaks and the dressing is not expanding?
good: 不能；持续复评并将新变化立即报告。
No; continue reassessment and report new changes immediately.
bad: 一次观察不能排除随后恶化。
One observation cannot exclude later deterioration.

title: 04 B：呼吸与胸部威胁
04 B: breathing and chest threats
info: 右胸局部压痛、起伏减弱，右侧呼吸音较左低；辅助呼吸肌参与。仍需同时考虑胸壁疼痛、肺损伤及气胸/血胸，不能仅凭这些资料诊断张力生理。

Right-sided tenderness, reduced chest excursion and quieter breath sounds; accessory muscles are active. Consider chest-wall pain, lung injury and pneumothorax/haemothorax together; these findings alone do not establish tension physiology.
unknown: 床旁影像尚未回报；氧合不反映全部通气状态。
Bedside imaging is not yet available; oxygenation does not describe ventilation fully.
priority: 团队立即评估呼吸威胁与支持需求，不为等待影像延误临床危急处理。
The team immediately assesses respiratory threats and support needs; critical clinical care must not be delayed for imaging.
reassess: RR、深度、说话、氧疗需求、SpO₂和意识一起比较。
Compare RR, depth, speech, oxygen requirement, SpO₂ and consciousness.

time: 到院0分钟 · 同一次初评
oxygen: 面罩氧疗6 L/min；实际FiO₂未测
Face-mask oxygen 6 L/min; actual FiO₂ unmeasured

question: 胸部CT能否先于当前威胁评估？
Should chest CT precede assessment of current threats?
good: 先结合生理处理立即威胁，床旁信息与复苏并行。
Address immediate threats using physiology; bedside information and resuscitation proceed together.
bad: 把CT当先决条件可能延误团队处理。
Making CT a prerequisite can delay team care.

title: 05 C：休克机制与早期检验
05 C: shock mechanisms and early tests
info: 脉搏快弱，毛细血管再充盈约4秒，四肢湿冷；左大腿肿胀并有伤口，腹部轻压痛。出血性休克高度担心，同时保留胸部阻塞性因素；尚未确认唯一来源。

Rapid weak pulse, capillary refill about 4 s and cool clammy limbs; swollen wounded left thigh and mild abdominal tenderness. Haemorrhagic shock is a major concern; retain obstructive chest causes without assigning one proven source.
unknown: 未有定量尿量或确定出血源；早期Hb不能单独排除大量失血。
No quantified urine output or confirmed bleeding source; early Hb cannot alone exclude major blood loss.
priority: 团队复苏、查找出血与胸部原因、血库及专科协调并行。
Team resuscitation, haemorrhage/chest assessment, blood-bank and specialty coordination run in parallel.
reassess: 灌注、意识、BP趋势和乳酸后续变化一起复评。
Reassess perfusion, consciousness, BP trends and subsequent lactate change together.

time: 到院0分钟 · 同一次初评
oxygen: 面罩氧疗6 L/min；实际FiO₂未测
Face-mask oxygen 6 L/min; actual FiO₂ unmeasured

question: Hb 118 g/L是否可以排除持续出血？
Does Hb 118 g/L exclude ongoing haemorrhage?
good: 不能，必须放回机制、体征和连续趋势。
No; interpret it with mechanism, examination and serial trends.
bad: 把单项Hb当止血证明会造成锚定。
Treating one Hb value as proof of haemostasis causes anchoring.
labs: 到院2分钟静脉采样：Hb 118 g/L；乳酸4.8 mmol/L；INR 1.3。用于教学的新设数值，不是阈值。
Venous sample at arrival +2 min: Hb 118 g/L; lactate 4.8 mmol/L; INR 1.3. Newly specified teaching values, not thresholds.

title: 06 D + E：神经、遗漏损伤与环境
06 D + E: neurology, missed injury and environment
info: GCS14（E4V4M6），瞳孔等大约3 mm、对光反应存在；四肢可按指令活动但左腿受疼痛限制。暴露检查发现腹部安全带痕与左大腿伤；持续保暖和隐私保护。未反复挤压骨盆以诱发不稳。

GCS 14 (E4V4M6), equal approximately 3-mm reactive pupils; obeys limb commands, left-leg movement limited by pain. Exposure reveals an abdominal seat-belt mark and left-thigh injury. Maintain warmth and privacy; do not repeatedly compress the pelvis to provoke instability.
unknown: 意识改变可能涉及头伤、低灌注或低氧；瞳孔正常不排除颅内损伤。
Altered consciousness may involve head injury, poor perfusion or hypoxia; normal pupils do not exclude intracranial injury.
priority: 保护、记录并补查遗漏损伤；新风险立即反馈x/A/B/C。
Protect, document and identify missed injury; new risks feed immediately back to x/A/B/C.
reassess: GCS分项、瞳孔、运动和体温与前次比较。
Compare GCS components, pupils, movement and temperature with prior observations.

question: 新发现应留到全部卡片读完才报告吗？
Should a new threat wait until every card is read?
good: 不应；教学顺序不等于临床等待顺序。
No; teaching order is not a clinical waiting sequence.
bad: 任何立即威胁都需及时团队处理。
Any immediate threat requires timely team attention.

title: 07 8分钟复评：氧合改善，灌注未解决
07 Reassessment at 8 min: oxygenation better, perfusion unresolved
info: 团队已复核敷料、气道、氧疗与呼吸表现，并启动复苏和出血源评估；未给出确定性操作或剂量。新测值提示氧合略改善，但仍心动过速、低血压和灌注担心。

The team has rechecked dressing, airway, oxygen delivery and respiratory findings, and initiated resuscitation and bleeding-source assessment; no definitive procedure or dose is specified. New observations show slightly better oxygenation but persistent tachycardia, low BP and perfusion concern.
unknown: 不能用SpO₂改善宣布稳定；出血源、胸部原因和乳酸趋势仍待明确。
Improved SpO₂ does not establish stability; bleeding source, chest causes and lactate trend remain unresolved.
priority: 重新排序x/B/C，明确责任人和下一次复评指标。
Reprioritise x/B/C; assign an owner and variables for the next reassessment.
reassess: 这是预设观察记录；选择题不改变这些数值，不模拟治疗的必然效果。
This is a scripted observation; quiz choices do not change these values or imply a guaranteed treatment effect.

time: 到院8分钟 · 新的观察记录
oxygen: 面罩氧疗6 L/min；实际FiO₂未测
Face-mask oxygen 6 L/min; actual FiO₂ unmeasured

question: 此时可以结束复苏观察吗？
Can resuscitation observation now end?
good: 不能，持续处理未解风险并比较趋势。
No; continue addressing unresolved risks and comparing trends.
bad: 单一指标改善不能代表整体恢复。
One improved variable does not establish overall recovery.
